item.title: High coffee intake linked to lower bone density, study suggests
item.description: A 10-year study of nearly 10,000 older women found that tea drinking was associated with slightly higher hip bone density, while excessive coffee consumption may weaken bones.

item.title: Early brain changes may precede Alzheimer's plaques by years
item.description: Brain changes associated with Alzheimer's may appear at least seven years before amyloid plaques are detectable on current PET scans, according to researchers.

item.title: Financial strain linked to faster brain aging
item.description: Long-term financial difficulties during early and middle adulthood were associated with reduced cognitive function in one's 50s and increased signs of brain aging later in life.

item.title: Giant scorpion roamed Earth before forests existed
item.description: A meter-long scorpion with large pincers inhabited ancient Britain 415 million years ago, predating forests and the later era of giant insects.
